resources.string: Measures mobile signal where you travel, including places with no service at all.
Records are kept on this phone until you reach an area with internet. Nothing is lost while you are out of coverage.

Location permission has not been granted. Without it the phone cannot read signal strength. Tap here to grant it.
Location is allowed only while the app is open, so recording will stop when the screen turns off. Tap here, then choose Permissions → Location → \"Allow all the time\".
Battery saving may stop recording while the screen is off. Tap here and choose \"Allow\" so this phone keeps collecting all day.

Recording continues while the phone is in your pocket or bag, so the app needs location access all the time. Without it, measurements stop the moment the screen turns off — and most of a journey would go unrecorded.\n\nOn the next screen, please choose “Allow all the time”.
Location permission is required. The phone cannot read which mobile towers are nearby without it.

This app records signal strength and position only. It does not collect your phone number, contacts, or any account. Positions are combined into map areas before anyone sees them.
